args.command: $media_extensions = @(".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".mp4", ".mov"); Get-ChildItem -Path gelen -Recurse -File | Where-Object { $media_extensions -contains $_.Extension.ToLower() } | ForEach-Object { $file = $_; $fileName = $file.Name; $datePattern = "(\d{4})[0-9]{2}(?:[-_]?\d{2})|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}"; if ( $fileName -match $datePattern ) { $dateString = $Matches[1] + ($fileName -match '(\d{2})' ? $Matches[2] : '00'); $year = $dateString.Substring(0, 4); $month = $dateString.Substring(4, 2); $destinationPath = "arsiv\$year\$month"; } else { $destinationPath = "arsiv\tarihsiz"; }; $destinationDir = Join-Path -Path (Get-Location) -ChildPath $destinationPath; if (-not (Test-Path $destinationDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $destinationDir | Out-Null }; Move-Item -Path $file.FullName -Destination $destinationDir -Force } | Out-Null
